question: On BOUNCE setups, does the volume-change ratio (volc5_50: recent 5d vs 50d avg volume) predict better follow-through? Expect HIGHER volc5_50 (accelerating volume into the down-cluster = capitulation) = better stop-R.
plain: Tests whether accelerating volume (5-day vs 50-day average) into a stock's down-day cluster predicts a better mean-reversion bounce.
